statement: theorem endpoint_values : (meanPredict (fun _ => 0) 0 - 0)^2 - (empiricalMean (fun _ => 0) 1 - 0)^2 = (1 : ℝ) / 4 ∧ (meanPredict (fun _ => 1) 0 - 1)^2 - (empiricalMean (fun _ => 1) 1 - 1)^2 = (1 : ℝ) / 4 ∧ (meanPredict (fun _ => 0) 0 - 0)^2 - (empiricalMean (fun _ => 0) 1 - 0)^2 ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 4 ∧ (meanPredict (fun _ => 1) 0 - 1)^2 - (empiricalMean (fun _ => 1) 1 - 1)^2 ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 4
